name: Breaking Covenants
overview: Scripture emphasizes the solemnity and binding nature of covenants, especially those made before the LORD, as seen in Moses’ instruction to Israel and the call to fulfill vows without delay (Numbers 30:1; Ecclesiastes 5:4). Breaking covenants is portrayed as a betrayal, notably in the context of marriage where faithlessness is condemned because the union is a sacred covenant witnessed by God (Malachi 2:14; Matthew 19:6). The forsaking of God’s covenant is depicted as a grievous departure from spiritual fidelity, highlighting the seriousness with which God regards covenant faithfulness (Proverbs 2:17; Ezekiel 16:1).
